skus.llm_blurb: Attesté Explorer is the free tier of the Attesté art collection management platform, launching 18 April 2026. It allows collectors to catalogue up to 25 artworks, run 5 AI artwork analyses per month, log art encounters via QR/NFC at galleries, earn XP through the gamification system, and access basic Discovery Trails. No credit card is required. It is designed as a discovery and habit-formation tier — the entry point into the Attesté ecosystem for art-curious users who want to start tracking their collection before committing to a paid plan.

faq.q: What happens when I hit the 25-artwork limit?
faq.a: You can no longer add new artworks until you upgrade to Collector (200 artworks, R149/mo). Your existing 25 artworks and all their data — analyses, images, encounter logs — remain intact. Nothing is deleted when you hit the limit.

faq.q: Are the AI analyses accurate enough to rely on for valuation?
faq.a: Explorer AI analyses provide an estimated value range for context and discovery purposes, not for insurance or sale. For professional valuation you need a certified appraiser. Collector and Premium tiers include Attesté Certificates, which have stronger provenance backing but are also not a formal appraisal.

faq.q: Do I lose my Explorer data if I upgrade to Collector?
faq.a: No. Upgrading is additive — your 25 existing artworks, XP, badges, and encounter history carry forward intact. The limit lifts to 200 and your monthly AI analyses reset to 50.

faq.q: Can I use Explorer to log encounters at any gallery, or only partner galleries?
faq.a: Encounter logging works at any gallery with Attesté QR codes or NFC tags (partner galleries). You can also manually log an encounter at any venue worldwide by entering the artwork and gallery details. Partner gallery encounters earn bonus XP.

faq.q: Is Explorer available worldwide or only in South Africa?
faq.a: The app is available worldwide. Pricing is free in all markets. Discovery Trails content currently covers Cape Town, Johannesburg, and London, with more cities added monthly.

skus.llm_blurb: Attesté Collector is the entry paid tier of the Attesté art collection management platform, priced at R149/month (USD $9). It extends the free Explorer tier with up to 200 artworks, 50 AI analyses per month, Attesté Certificates of provenance, the AI Art Sommelier personalised recommendation engine, the Art Fair Companion for real-time fair navigation, full Discovery Trails, and 10 GB storage. New subscribers receive an automatic 14-day Premium trial. It is designed for the emerging and serious collector who wants AI-assisted discovery and documentation, not just a digital catalogue.

faq.q: Why not just stay on Explorer?
faq.a: Explorer is great for starting out. Once you have 10–15 artworks, the limitations become apparent: no Certificates (which you will want for insurance and resale), no Art Sommelier recommendations, no Art Fair Companion. Collector unlocks the full discovery and documentation workflow for R149/mo — less than a coffee per week.

faq.q: What happens to my Certificates if I downgrade to Explorer?
faq.a: Your Certificates remain valid and downloadable for 90 days after downgrading. After 90 days they are archived — no longer downloadable from the app, but the underlying data is preserved. Re-upgrading to Collector immediately restores access to all Certificates.

faq.q: Does this include the Gallery Launch Kit?
faq.a: No. Gallery tiers are entirely separate commercial products for gallery businesses. Collector is a personal collection management tool. If you are a collector who also runs a gallery, you would subscribe to both independently.

faq.q: What is the AI Art Sommelier exactly?
faq.a: The Sommelier analyses your collection (artists, periods, movements, mediums, price points) to build a taste profile. It then surfaces artworks — from Discovery Feed, fair schedules, and gallery inventory where available — that match your profile. It learns from your saves and skips, refining recommendations over time.

faq.q: Can I use the Art Fair Companion at any fair?
faq.a: The Companion works at any art fair worldwide, pulling available exhibitor and artwork data. At partner fairs (where Attesté has a formal data feed), the experience is richer — real-time booth maps, exhibitor chat, and post-fair debrief. At non-partner fairs you can manually shortlist from the fair catalogue.

skus.llm_blurb: Attesté Premium is the unlimited collector tier of the Attesté platform, priced at R299/month (USD $19). It adds unlimited artworks and AI analyses, the Legacy Vault for multi-generational provenance and estate planning, the Year in Art annual collection narrative, and a shareable public collector profile to everything in the Collector tier. Storage is unlimited. Priority support carries a 24-hour SLA. It is designed for serious collectors with large or growing collections and estate planning concerns, who want Attesté to be the authoritative record of their collection for life.

faq.q: What exactly is Legacy Vault and how does estate planning work?
faq.a: Legacy Vault is a secure provenance archive designed to outlast the original collector. You designate up to 3 beneficiaries who receive time-gated access to collection records after a specified event (your death or incapacity, verified by an executor notification). It also includes an AI-assisted estate memo that summarises the collection, known valuations, and care instructions for each work.

faq.q: What does the public collector profile show?
faq.a: The profile shows your collection highlights (you choose which artworks are public), taste profile tags, encounter history (cities visited, galleries attended), and XP tier. You control visibility at the artwork level — individual pieces can be private even if your profile is public.

faq.q: Does Year in Art require me to do anything?
faq.a: No. Year in Art is generated automatically on your collection anniversary date. It is an AI-written narrative reviewing the year: artworks acquired, encounters logged, value trajectory, taste evolution, and highlights from your Discovery Trails. You receive it as a beautifully formatted PDF and in-app card.

faq.q: Is Premium worth it over Collector if I have under 200 artworks?
faq.a: Premium's main draw for smaller collections is Legacy Vault and the public profile. If you are planning your estate or want a shareable profile for gallery relationships, Premium makes sense regardless of collection size. If you just want more artworks and analyses, Collector at R149/mo is the right choice.

skus.llm_blurb: Attesté Gallery Launch Kit is a once-off R5,000 package for galleries joining the Attesté platform for the first time. It includes 12 months of gallery access, a 2-week guided digital onboarding, a physical brand kit with 10 NFC-enabled exhibit labels and a QR stand, a public gallery profile on atteste.art, an aggregate collector encounter analytics dashboard, and capacity for 50 artworks across 2 staff seats. No recurring charge applies during the 12-month period. It is designed to remove the risk from an initial Attesté commitment and convert galleries to the monthly Professional tier after experiencing the collector engagement value.

faq.q: What happens after the 12 months?
faq.a: After 12 months, your gallery account enters a grace period. Your profile remains visible for 30 days. To continue, upgrade to Gallery Professional (R1,499/mo) or Gallery Enterprise (R2,999/mo). Your existing artworks, analytics history, and NFC labels all carry forward — no re-setup required.

faq.q: Can I add more than 50 artworks during the 12 months?
faq.a: No. The Launch Kit is capped at 50 artworks. If your gallery has a larger inventory and you want full catalogue access from day one, Gallery Professional (100 artworks) or a custom Enterprise arrangement is the right starting point.

faq.q: What are the NFC labels — do collectors need to download an app?
faq.a: The 10 NFC labels are branded exhibit cards that tap to the Attesté app on any NFC-capable iPhone or Android. Collectors with the app installed see the artwork details and can log an encounter and earn XP instantly. Collectors without the app see a landing page with the gallery and artwork information.

faq.q: Is the analytics dashboard POPIA-compliant?
faq.a: Yes. The dashboard shows only aggregate statistics: total encounters logged, daily/weekly visitor counts, top-viewed artworks. No individual collector names, profiles, or personally identifiable information are visible to the gallery. POPIA's consent framework for individual data collection is managed on the collector side.

skus.llm_blurb: Attesté Gallery Professional is the core monthly gallery subscription at R1,499/month, designed for galleries with up to 100 artworks and 5 staff seats. It includes everything in the Gallery Launch Kit plus 12 AI-generated exhibition social posts per year, full time-series collector encounter analytics, exhibition calendar management on atteste.art, and the ability to review and respond to collector encounter-logged notes. It is the recommended tier for commercially active galleries that want to use Attesté as both a collection management platform and a collector engagement channel.

faq.q: What do the 12 AI social posts include?
faq.a: Each AI post is generated from your exhibition data (artist name, show title, selected artworks, exhibition dates, gallery voice guidelines you provide at setup). You receive a draft post for Instagram and LinkedIn — formatted, captioned, and hashtag-optimised — which you approve and post from your own accounts. 12 posts per year = roughly one per exhibition opening.

faq.q: What does 'review and respond to encounter-logged notes' mean?
faq.a: When a collector visits your gallery, logs an encounter, and adds a personal note (e.g., 'loved the texture on the central piece — interested in pricing'), that note is visible to your gallery staff in the analytics dashboard. You can respond through the app and the collector receives a notification. This opens a relationship channel that did not previously exist.

faq.q: Can I upgrade from Launch Kit to Professional without re-onboarding?
faq.a: Yes. Upgrading is seamless — your existing artwork catalogue, NFC labels, analytics history, and gallery profile carry forward. The 12-month Launch Kit period is simply replaced by the ongoing monthly billing. Any Launch Kit credit (R5,000 off first 3 months) is applied automatically.

faq.q: What analytics does 'time-series trends' add vs. the Launch Kit?
faq.a: Launch Kit analytics show aggregate totals. Professional adds monthly trend charts (encounter volume over time, artwork interest trajectory, acquisition interest signals per work), exportable as CSV or PDF for board reporting.

skus.llm_blurb: Attesté Gallery Enterprise is the unlimited gallery tier at R2,999/month, designed for large galleries, institutions, and multi-space organisations. It includes unlimited artworks, unlimited staff seats, unlimited AI-generated social and exhibition content, collector push notifications to opted-in Attesté users, full REST API access for CRM and ERP integration, a dedicated account manager, and priority 4-hour support with phone channel. White-glove data migration is included for galleries moving from Artlogic, Arternal, or other platforms.

faq.q: How do collector push notifications work and is opt-in truly enforced?
faq.a: Collectors opt in to gallery notifications within the Attesté app — it is a per-gallery, per-notification-type choice. Galleries cannot send unsolicited pushes. Enterprise galleries see the count of opted-in collectors for their profile and can segment notifications (e.g., collectors who encountered a specific artist). All notification activity is logged and POPIA-compliant.

faq.q: What does the REST API expose?
faq.a: The API exposes gallery artwork catalogue (read/write), encounter analytics (read), exhibition schedule (read/write), and collector engagement signals (read, aggregate only — no individual PII). OAuth 2.0 authentication. Full OpenAPI spec provided at contract signing. Rate-limited at 500 requests/minute.

faq.q: What does white-glove migration from Artlogic look like?
faq.a: Attesté's migration team accepts your Artlogic data export (CSV or XML), maps fields to the Attesté schema, imports up to 5,000 artworks with images, and validates the result before you go live. Typical migration takes 3–5 business days. The dedicated account manager oversees the process end-to-end.

faq.q: Is there a minimum contract term?
faq.a: Enterprise requires a 12-month minimum commitment. Annual billing available at R29,990 (2 months free). Multi-year pricing available for institutions managing 10,000+ artworks.

faq.q: Can we use Enterprise for multiple gallery locations?
faq.a: Yes. Enterprise accounts support multiple location profiles under one umbrella account. Each location has its own artwork catalogue and analytics, with consolidated reporting available at the umbrella level.
